observed_title: Anti-concentration of Suprema of Gaussian Processes and Gaussian Order Statistics

read_ranges.scope: 全文逐页阅读：有限 Gaussian 场 order-statistic 与无限可分 Gaussian process 反集中主结果、方差上下界、order-statistic 密度与 s-concavity、全部证明和参考文献

topic_relevance.K04: direct（高斯反集中核心）：给出任意可分中心高斯过程 supremum 的两侧 concentration-function 界，常数因子匹配；还处理 Gaussian 场 order statistics 并给 supremum 方差上下界。只覆盖 Gaussian/其 order-statistic 机制，不提供一般经验过程的 Gaussian 近似误差。

definitions.name: separable centered Gaussian process
definitions.statement: X={X_u:u∈U} 的有限维边缘为零均值多元高斯；存在可数 U₀ 与概率一集合，使任意索引点附近的过程值可由 U₀ 的值逼近，因此 sup 可写为可数上确界并可测。

definitions.name: absolute supremum
definitions.statement: 对可分中心 Gaussian process，令 Z̃=sup_{u∈U}|X_u|，要求 Z̃<∞ a.s.; Theorem2 的方差是 Var(Z̃)，不是 sup_u Var(X_u)。

definitions.name: order statistic density
definitions.statement: 在 Var(X_i)>0 且 Corr(X_i,X_j)<1(i≠j) 的有限 Gaussian field 中，第 k 个次序统计量 X_(k) 有密度 f_{k,n}(z)，由选择恰有 n−k 个坐标高于 z 的条件正态密度求和表示。

theorem_cards.label: Theorem 1 / Corollary 1 (有限 Gaussian 场 order statistic 与绝对最大值)
assumptions: 有限 Gaussian random field X={X_i:i≤n}，Var(X_i)>0 且任意 i≠j 有 Corr(X_i,X_j)<1。
任意 ε>0 与 1≤k≤n；order statistic 也可换为 |X_i| 的 k-th order statistic。
Corollary1 对 max_i|X_i| 可移除边缘/两两相关非退化假设，允许删除零方差或完全相同的冗余坐标。
theorem_cards.statement: ε/[√12·√(Var(X_(k))+ε²/12)] ≤ Q(X_(k),ε) ≤ ε√12/√(Var(X_(k))+ε²/12)。对 max_i|X_i| 的 Corollary1 有同形式界且不需上述非退化限制。
proof_steps: 先证明 Gaussian order statistic 具有密度，得到 Q(X_(k),ε)=ε M(X_(k)+εU)，U 独立均匀(0,1)。
证明 order statistic 的分布与加独立均匀变量后仍具有任意 s<0 的 s-concavity。
对 s-concave 实分布控制位置尺度不变积 Var(Z)M²(Z)，下界为 1/12，上界为 4(1+s)³/[(1+3s)(1+2s)²]。
取 s=−1/6，得上界 √12，合并成定理界；Corollary1 用 ±X_i 展开 max|X_i|，删除退化/完全相关重复坐标再应用定理。
gaps: 上界常数不是最优；论文说明依赖 s=−1/6 的统一选取。
Corollary1 若所有坐标都退化为0，则 Q=1 且上界直接成立，原文单独指出左界取等。
theorem_cards.proof_verification: full_text_read; statement visually checked on PDF p.3; full proof and s-concavity chain on pp.14–21 read, key bound visually checked p.19 and conclusion p.21.

theorem_cards.label: Theorem 2 (任意可分中心 Gaussian supremum 反集中)
assumptions: X={X_u:u∈U} 是可分中心 Gaussian process。
不要求有限维边缘非退化；若 Var(Z̃)=0 则按原文直接处理。
theorem_cards.statement: ε/[√12·√(Var(Z̃)+ε²/12)] ≤ Q(Z̃,ε) ≤ ε√12/√(Var(Z̃)+ε²/12)。Remark2 允许 Z=sup_u X_u 的非中心情形，只需 inf_u Var(X_u)>0。
proof_steps: 下界由 Remark1 的任意随机变量通用下界直接得出。
对上界，用可分性选嵌套有限子集 U_n，使 Z̃_n=max_{u∈U_n}|X_u|→Z̃ a.s.
应用 Corollary1 控制 Q(Z̃_n,ε)，再以连续分布函数的反三角不等式和高斯 supremum 的反向 Lyapunov/支配收敛得到 Q 与 Var 的极限，令 n→∞。
gaps: 界按 Var(sup|X|) 表达；仅有 marginal 最大方差或一个粗 Gaussian comparison 不足以替代该方差。
Z=sup X_u 的非中心推广要求所有一维方差有正统一下界。
theorem_cards.proof_verification: full_text_read; assumptions and constants visually checked on PDF p.4; finite-net limit proof read.

theorem_cards.label: Proposition 1–2 (supremum 方差的下界和相关性上界)
assumptions: Proposition1: 可分中心 Gaussian process, inf_u Var(X_u)≥σ²>0, Z=sup X_u<∞ a.s.；亦适用于 sup|X_u|。
Proposition2: sup_u Var(X_u)≤ arσ² 且 |Cor(X_u,X_v)|≤ρ 对所有 u,v；Z 有限 a.s.；亦适用于 sup|X_u|。
theorem_cards.statement: Prop.1: Var(Z)≥(1/15²)[σ/(1+E[Z/σ])]²。Prop.2: Var(Z)≤2² arσ² ∧ {11² arσ²ρ+60²[ arσ/((E[Z/ arσ]−3√log2)_+)]²}。
proof_steps: Prop.1 对 E[Z/σ]≤1/2 用 Chebyshev 与 Gaussian Mills 下界；大均值时用 independent copy、Ding–Eldan–Zhai 技术引理、Cantelli 界得到 Var(Z/σ)(1+E[Z/σ])²≥常数，再取保守常数 1/15²。
Prop.2 建立有限维 Gaussian 向量的技术引理：按协方差阈值 r₀ 覆盖高相关坐标块，控制 argmax 落入块的最大概率，利用 Gaussian covariance identity 与超收缩得尾界。
由各坐标取值概率受大均值 Gaussian 尾控制，代入技术引理；有限网格逼近可分 sup，并积分尾界得到所列方差上界。
gaps: Lemma2 的技术证明作者明确说仅 sketch，引用 Tanguy (2015) 作关键超收缩/协方差估计；正文未逐行证明。
Prop.2 的相关系数上界需要全索引集统一相关控制；ρ大时该上界可能不比 4 arσ² 简单界更强。
theorem_cards.proof_verification: full_text_read; Prop.1 bound visually checked p.8 and derivation conclusion p.10; Prop.2 statement visually checked p.10; proof read, but its central technical lemma is explicitly sketched rather than fully derived.

theorem_cards.label: Propositions 3–5 (order-statistic density, s-concavity and variance–mode bridge)
assumptions: Prop.3 finite Gaussian field with positive marginal variances and pairwise Corr<1.
Prop.4 additionally U is an independent uniform variable on any interval; X_(k) and X_(k)+U retain s-concave laws/densities for every s<0.
Prop.5 Z has s-concave distribution for s∈(−1/3,0].
theorem_cards.statement: Prop.3 gives the explicit order-statistic density. Prop.4 proves s-concavity preservation under independent uniform convolution. Prop.5: 1/12≤Var(Z)M²(Z)≤4(1+s)³/[(1+3s)(1+2s)²]; the lower bound is universal and tight for the uniform distribution.
proof_steps: Partition the infinitesimal event z<X_(k)≤z+ε according to the unique coordinate crossing and the indices above z; condition on the crossing coordinate to derive the density.
Represent the density terms using Gaussian residuals independent of the crossing coordinate; apply Borell s-concavity and preservation under products/convolution.

For Prop.5 rescale the density mode to 1. A universal interval-mass argument gives Var≥1/12. For the upper bound write variance as a quantile double integral, use the concavity of a power of density-at-quantile to lower bound that density and integrate.
gaps: The s-concavity machinery is specialized to one-dimensional order statistics and convolution with a uniform variable.
Prop.5 upper constant is explicitly noted as loose; only lower 1/12 is tight.
theorem_cards.proof_verification: full_text_read; density formula visually checked p.14, variance-mode inequality p.19, quantile proof conclusion p.21.

constant_dependence.explicit: Theorem1/Theorem2 have universal multiplicative constants 1/√12 and √12; they depend on Z only through Var(Z)+ε²/12. Prop.1 and Prop.2 give explicit universal numerical factors 15², 2², 11², and 60².
constant_dependence.dependence: Variance lower bound depends on the marginal variance floor and E[sup]/σ; the sharpened upper bound depends on uniform pairwise correlation bound ρ and normalized expected supremum.

endpoint_limits.finite_field: Theorem1 for order stats requires positive marginal variances and excludes pairwise perfect positive correlation; the absolute maximum Corollary removes this by eliminating duplicate/zero coordinates.
endpoint_limits.process: Theorem2 applies to separable centered Gaussian processes with finite absolute supremum a.s., without requiring nondegenerate finite-dimensional marginals. Noncentered one-sided supremum needs inf marginal variance>0.
endpoint_limits.approximation: The article gives anti-concentration for Gaussian laws; it does not itself prove a non-Gaussian empirical-process-to-Gaussian approximation or bootstrap error bound.
endpoint_limits.scale: If Var(sup|X|) collapses with dimension/entropy, the two-sided bound remains meaningful only with that actual variance scale; replacing it by sup marginal variance can lose correlation gains.

reusable_methods.transfer: First establish the target statistic is a measurable separable Gaussian supremum and control Var(Z) at the needed dimension/entropy. Then substitute its variance and ε into the two-sided Q bound; if the target is non-Gaussian, add a separate approximation error.
reusable_methods.limit: Variance is that of the supremum itself, which may be much smaller than the maximum coordinate variance.

reusable_methods.method: Smoothing connects density mode and concentration probability
reusable_methods.transfer: For a statistic with density, use Q(Z,ε)=εM(Z+εU) and control Var(Z+εU)M²(Z+εU) over the class generated by uniform convolution.
reusable_methods.limit: The s-concavity preservation proof here is specific to Gaussian order statistics; it is not automatically valid for arbitrary statistics.
